status: FROZEN for W17 (cfg ROM, array spine) and W18 (die assembly), 2026-09-30; changes need a new version
rtl: rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_rom_elem.sv (FP8/FP4 macro pairs harden through rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_rom_elem_q.sv, which ties the BF16 port off)

clock_and_reset.clk: one clock; the element gates its own logic with one ICG (ot_hdc_cg): clocked from `go` until DRAIN cycles after its walkers stop; configuration registers stay on clk

configuration.port: cfg_v, cfg_a[4:0], cfg_d[47:0]: one register write per cycle, any order, before `go`; must not change during an op

bits.[15:0]: row tag (bit 15 = idle half: no partial emitted)
bits.[27]: low chunk of the first unit present
bits.[28]: high chunk of the last unit present
bits.[41:29]: ROM base address of the segment's words

bits.[8:1]: first unit (chunk pair / BF16 lane group)

class_entry.rule: segment slots of a class are contiguous and ordered by (fmt, row); classes of one element are disjoint unit ranges in ascending order

bits.[15:0]: row tag of segment s on the pair's second macro (bit 15 = idle)

configuration.writes_per_op: up to 25 (8 segments + 8 classes + 1 global + 8 pair rows); an op using k segments and j classes needs k + j + 1 + k
configuration.generator: tools/rtl_v41_rom_array.py build_phase (per element: segments, classes, bases from tools/v41_rom_ksplit_bankmap.py)

op_start.go: one-cycle pulse; go_bf in the same cycle selects the x family (0: FP8/FP4 stream xs_*, 1: BF16 stream xb_*)
op_start.x_stream: beats may start the cycle after go; for MTP, position p's rounds follow position p-1's (xs_pos / xb_pos tag each beat)

fp8_fp4.ports: xs_v, xs_p[7:0] pair index, xs_b[2:0] block, xs_sv[1:0] slot valid, xs_q0/xs_e0 chunk 2p codes+exp, xs_q1/xs_e1 chunk 2p+1, xs_pos[2:0]
fp8_fp4.order: round (q, b): the needed pairs in ascending order; rounds in (position, q, b) order; a round lasts >= 5 cycles; spacing so an element never holds more than XF slices

bf16.ports: xb_v, xb_b[2:0], xb_sv[3:0], xb_u[4x8] lane-group ids, xb_d[4x256] (16 BF16 per slot: element h*128 + l*8 + b), xb_pos[2:0]
bf16.order: round (q, b): needed lane groups ascending, up to 4 per beat

outputs.partial: per macro m: pv[m], pval[32m+:32] FP32 node, prow[16m+:16], pseg[5m+:5], pnseg[5m+:5], perr[m], ppos[3m+:3]
outputs.meaning: {position, row, segment lo, level 0, segments}: a golden csum node over the row's segment; the return network adds golden siblings (ot_v41_ret_node/root)
outputs.rate: at most one partial per macro per cycle

status_outputs.fault: sticky: x FIFO overflow, chain recurrence violation, tree queue overflow, BF16 product fault
